reason: A better-sidebar plugin that previews supported local video files inline with playback controls, seeking via HTTP Range streaming, and downloading.

summaries.zh: 为 better-sidebar 提供本地视频文件内联预览、播放控制、进度拖拽和下载功能。
summaries.en: Adds inline previews for supported local video files in better-sidebar with playback controls, seeking, and downloading.

capabilities: Registers a video file previewer for supported video extensions
Streams local video files through a host route with HTTP Range support
Provides browser video playback controls and a download link
